item.title: [ Mod ] KM Style Michiru Kagemori (Rochelle) with L4D Styled Icons
item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 4
This is a personal custom-edit mod of 7EMP3ST’s KM style Michiru Kagemori (Rochelle) mod. It alters the VGUI/HUD icons (the Lobby, Panel, and Incap icons) to a cleaner L4D-styled look. I also slightly edited the jacket textures, removing the gray parts from the original model since they looked out of place. I made this edit because while the original portraits that come with the original model of the mod are not bad by any stretch, they don't match the portraits that come with the majority of skin mods from other modders. Original Mod: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?l=spanish&id=3084780837 Michiru Kagemori is from "BNA: Brand New Animal"

item.title: [ 5 Maps ] Paradise of Doom
item.description:
View Article
Media
Media gallery
1 / 8
A sunny resort welcomes the survivors with promises of a rescue! Travel with Nick, Coach, Ellis and Rochelle through a paradise with the dead... FEATURES: Paradise of Doom is a 5 Chapter Campaign, every single game mode is playable! 4 Years of Development went into this campaign! The idea for this campaign started when I was 10 years old, many of the ideas from this campaign are from when I was a kid dreaming of how I would make this campaign. Chapters include a Shipwreck (Map 1), Lakeside (Map 2), Resort (Map 3), Casino (Map 4), and Beach (Map 5)! Versus is Compatible! Survival is playable, every single map is available! Scavenge is playable! Three Maps are available! (Maps 1,3,5) 2 New Melee Weapons: Sledge Hammer (From Whispers of Winter), and a brand new Pickaxe! New Tank Skins with RNG Colors! (Tank Wearing Swimming Shorts with Sunglasses) New Common Infected Variants! (Swimming Shorts Infected, Resort Staff Infected) A sequel to Whispers of Winter Custom Music by PandaSkyz (Same composer behind Whispers of Winter’s OST) A sunny paradise campaign with survivor voice lines, custom graffiti, custom models/textures This campaign actually has nothing to do with Dead Island, but that’s the number one question I get asked. It's based on a real-life resort in Florida (Hammock Beach Resort)!
